# Subham Travelers — Comprehensive Agent Knowledge Base

> Subham Travelers is Silk City Berhampur's direct chauffeur-driven cab operator and outstation taxi service in Odisha, India.

## Contact & Dispatch Coordinates
- Business Name: Subham Travelers
- Operational Headquarters: Station Road / MKCG Hospital Transit Zone, Berhampur (Silk City), Ganjam, Odisha - 760001, India
- Latitude / Longitude: 19.3149, 84.7941
- Telephone Hotline: +91 63712 58522 (Phone URI: tel:+916371258522)
- WhatsApp Support: https://wa.me/916371258522
- Primary Service Coverage: All 30 districts of Odisha with daily scheduled runs to Bhubaneswar, Cuttack, Puri, Gopalpur, and Andhra Pradesh border corridors (Visakhapatnam, Srikakulam).

## Vehicle Fleet Details
1. Sedan Dzire / Etios
   - Seating Capacity: 4 Passengers + Chauffeur
   - Luggage Capacity: 3 Large Suitcases + Soft Bags
   - Amenities: Air Conditioning, Chilled AC vents, Fast-charging USB, Clean seat covers
   - Best For: Executive one-way highway drops, Bhubaneswar Airport transfers, railway station pick-and-drop.
2. Ertiga MPV
   - Seating Capacity: 6 Passengers + Chauffeur
   - Luggage Capacity: 4 Bags + Overhead Carrier
   - Amenities: Dual Air Conditioning vents, flexible fold-flat luggage row
   - Best For: Family temple darshans, weekend getaways, Gopalpur beach excursions.
3. Innova Crysta
   - Seating Capacity: 7 Passengers + Chauffeur
   - Luggage Capacity: 5 Heavy Bags + Boot Space
   - Amenities: Captain luxury seating, independent climate control, superior highway comfort
   - Best For: VIP corporate travel, multi-day long-distance Odisha circuit journeys.
4. Tempo Traveller
   - Seating Capacity: 12 to 26 Passengers + Chauffeur
   - Best For: Marriage groups, college excursions, large group pilgrimage circuits.

## Key Travel Corridors from Berhampur
- Berhampur to Bhubaneswar Biju Patnaik Airport (BBI): 172 km (~3 hours via NH-16)
- Berhampur to Puri Jagannath Temple: 165 km (~3.5 hours via NH-16 & Coastal Highway)
- Berhampur to Gopalpur-on-Sea: 16 km (~25 minutes)
- Berhampur to Tara Tarini Shakti Peetha: 30 km (~45 minutes via SH-32)
- Berhampur to Tampara Lake Water Sports: 25 km (~35 minutes)
- Berhampur to Taptapani Hot Water Spring & Jirang Monastery: 55 to 85 km (~2.5 hours)
- Berhampur to Daringbadi (Kashmir of Odisha): 120 km (~3.5 hours)

## Booking Process
Travelers can submit online booking enquiries through https://berhampurcab.vercel.app/ or call the 24x7 operations desk directly at +91 63712 58522. Fixed quotations include fuel, chauffeur allowance, and highway toll coordination.
